8f8ecfaa6d22de33.name: Stellantis Brampton plant sale

keys.text: Stellantis agreed to keep talking with Ottawa and Ontario about the Brampton plant sale, with discussions continuing the following week.

src.title: Stellantis agrees to continue talks, as Ottawa seeks to head off sale of Brampton plant

keys.text: A federal source says Stellantis would owe Ottawa $831M if the sale of the Brampton plant proceeds.

src.title: Stellantis would owe feds $831M if sale of Brampton, Ont., plant proceeds: source

8f8ecfaa6d22de33.stands: Stellantis has agreed to keep talking with Ottawa and Ontario about selling its idled Brampton plant, with a federal source putting Stellantis's potential repayment at $831M if the sale proceeds. Stellantis has also sued Unifor over a blockade at the plant.

249de3c98f169d72.name: Canada-U.S. CUSMA trade talks

keys.text: Premier Doug Ford says he will not support a U.S.-Canada trade deal that does not consider Ontario's industries.

src.title: Ford will not back a U.S.-Canada deal that doesn’t consider Ontario’s industries

keys.text: Trump has threatened a 50% tariff, and the auto sector remains a sticking point in Canada-U.S. trade talks.

src.title: Auto still standing in way of Canada-U.S. trade deal as Trump’s 50% tariff threat looms

249de3c98f169d72.stands: Canada-U.S. CUSMA-related trade talks are ongoing with no deal announced. Ontario Premier Ford will not back a deal that ignores Ontario's industries, and a 50% U.S. tariff threat on Canada still looms over auto trade.

123f2af7e39d944e.name: Ford and Ontario auto investments

keys.text: Ford's Oakville assembly plant reopened after retooling for Super Duty production.

src.title: Ford assembly plant reopens in Oakville, Ont.

keys.text: Canada and Ontario are providing C$928.5 million in funding for the Ford Oakville plant revamp.

src.title: Ford’s Oakville expansion gets $928.5M boost

123f2af7e39d944e.stands: Ford's Oakville, Ontario assembly plant has reopened after retooling for Super Duty production. Canada and Ontario's C$928.5 million funding for the revamp is now confirmed, while the $5 billion investment figure is still awaiting trusted confirmation.

c4231109fe08a183.name: Chinese automakers and EV concerns

keys.text: Chinese automakers are rushing to use Canada's EV quota but are stalling on building vehicles locally.

src.title: China automakers rush to take advantage of Canada EV quota but stall on local assembly

c4231109fe08a183.stands: Chinese automakers are rushing to use Canada's EV import quota but are stalling on local assembly. An auto industry expert has voiced significant concern about Chinese investment in Canada's auto sector.

28f3f10389ea9c60.name: Stellantis sues Unifor over Brampton

keys.text: Stellantis sued Unifor in Ontario court, alleging the union trespassed at its Brampton plant and obstructed environmental work.

src.title: Stellantis sues Unifor, alleging obstruction of environmental work at Brampton plant
Stellantis taking Unifor to court over obstruction of environmental work
Stellantis suing Unifor, accuses union of blocking access to Brampton plant

keys.text: The Brampton plant was sold to defence contractor Roshel.

src.title: Stellantis sues Unifor, alleging obstruction of environmental work at Brampton plant

28f3f10389ea9c60.stands: Stellantis is suing Unifor in Ontario court, alleging the union trespassed at and obstructed environmental work at its Brampton plant. The plant was sold to defence contractor Roshel.

44757ecdb92cb82c.name: After talks with Stellantis, Ford says Ottawa must drop indu

keys.text: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says Ottawa must drop industrial carbon pricing, following talks with Stellantis.

src.title: After talks with Stellantis, Ford says Ottawa must drop industrial carbon pricing

44757ecdb92cb82c.stands: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says Ottawa must drop industrial carbon pricing, a position he stated after talks with Stellantis. No federal response is on record yet.

225efa7712166492.name: Canada-U.S. CUSMA trade talks

keys.text: Trump's trade representative says the U.S. is looking to accommodate Canada on some sectoral tariffs and that a U.S. trade deal must accommodate Canada.

src.title: Trump’s trade czar says he’s looking to accommodate Canada on some sectoral tariffs
U.S. trade deal must ‘accommodate’ Canada, says Trump’s representative

225efa7712166492.stands: The U.S. trade representative says Washington is looking to accommodate Canada on some sectoral tariffs in the ongoing CUSMA talks. No deal or specific tariff changes have been announced.

a8a4f89633edeabf.name: MAID mental illness exclusion proposal

keys.text: Ottawa proposed a bill to indefinitely exclude people seeking MAID on mental illness alone from assisted dying eligibility.

src.title: Why Canada’s psychiatrists are issuing a caution on Ottawa’s new MAID bill

a8a4f89633edeabf.stands: Ottawa has proposed a bill that would indefinitely exclude people with mental illnesses from MAID eligibility, and psychiatrists are cautioning against it. A minister has stated that MAID was never meant for mental illness.

a0a0a704eabe9f8b.name: China EV quota gas vehicle concern
a0a0a704eabe9f8b.stands: Automakers have raised concerns that China could use Canada's EV import quota to bring in gasoline vehicles. No decisions, figures, or official positions are on record yet.

04836e8f6fe25814.name: Semaglutide vision loss warning

keys.text: Health Canada issued a warning that a safety review found a possible link between semaglutide GLP-1 drugs and a rare form of vision loss.

src.title: Health Canada issues warning on rare risk of vision loss with semaglutide GLP-1 drugs
GLP-1s may carry ‘very rare but serious risk of vision loss’: Health Canada
The National | Wegovy, Ozempic pose rare vision loss risk: Health Canada

04836e8f6fe25814.stands: Health Canada has warned that semaglutide GLP-1 drugs may carry a very rare but serious risk of vision loss, following a safety review. The warning names Wegovy and Ozempic among the affected products.

5a05b17b88228e62.name: Unifor and Ford joint statement

keys.text: Premier Doug Ford and Unifor National President Lana Payne jointly called on Ottawa to scrap greenhouse gas rules for Canadian automakers.

src.title: Premier Ford, Unifor leader call on Ottawa to scrap greenhouse gas rules for Canadian automakers
Premier Ford, Unifor leader call on feds to scrap greenhouse gas rules for Canadian automakers
Joint statement by Unifor National President Lana Payne and Premier Doug Ford

keys.text: Ottawa rejected calls from Ford and Unifor to exempt automakers from greenhouse gas rules, and the Environment Minister defended the tailpipe rules.

src.title: Ottawa rejects call to relieve Canadian automakers of greenhouse gas rules

5a05b17b88228e62.stands: Premier Doug Ford and Unifor President Lana Payne called on Ottawa on 2026-11-26 to scrap greenhouse gas rules for automakers. Ottawa rejected the call on 2026-11-27, with the Environment Minister defending the tailpipe rules.
